generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a slender, clonal tree with a narrow crown and small, round, finely toothed leaves on flattened stalks. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 15 m tall and 25 cm across at breast height at 40 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaves; smooth, chalky white bark with dark scars. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth whitish bark with dark marks and lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Leaf families (plant roadmap P4, `families`): sun leaves somewhat smaller and narrower than shade leaves; set from general knowledge of sun and shade leaves and juvenile foliage, not measured.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
